sous_titre: Capitaux des réassureurs mondiaux, en Mds $, de fin 2024 à fin mars 2026

2024.texte: Global reinsurer capital increased by almost 7% over the course of 2024 to a new high of $715 billion

2025.texte: Global reinsurer capital increased by almost 10% in 2025, ending the year at a record $785 billion

T1 2026.texte: Global reinsurer capital rose by $5 billion to a new high of $790 billion at March 31, 2026
